objective: Test whether a fixed-256-row FP8 qkvz projection removes the layer-0 prefill shape variance isolated by R86 and restores strict c2 output identity.

candidate.implementation: For qkvz calls with at least 17 rows, split into blocks of at most 256 rows, zero-pad each partial block to exactly 256 rows, invoke the existing quantized in_proj_qkvz module, and retain only real rows. Do not change weights, scales, output dtype, or calls below 17 rows.
candidate.reason: The existing fixed-256 BA projection is bitwise invariant at layer 0; R86 found the adjacent FP8 qkvz projection was not.

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 in the same fresh server.

followup_if_pass: Build a non-tracing candidate and run the broader varied-prompt deterministic quality battery plus repeated c1/c2 performance. This trace run cannot promote speed.
promotion_boundary: Candidate only. No site, README, headline, protected-speed, recipe-default, or LocalMaxxing authority. This boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
